(a)༄༅/ /ston mchog gang las byon pa'i shākya rnams kyi sngon rabs gleng ba'i chos gtam dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gse

tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄༅// ston mchog gang las byon pa'i shākya rnams kyi sngon rabs gleng ba'i chos gtam dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gser mngal mig stong pa sogs 'jig rten 'dir// che bar rlom dgu ral pa'i cod paṇa rtses// gang gi zhabs zung 'khor los mtshan pa la// yang yang btud byas shākya seng ger 'dud// gang 'dir skye ba bzung tshul bstan pa'i rigs// shākya rnams kyi sngon rabs rigs brgyud gtam// brjod pa yon tan snying pos lci ba gang*// lus las rnyed pa nyung zad mchid du gleng*// 'jig rten dag ni 'dod la zhen pa yis// phyir zhing nyams pa'i rang bzhin ma thob su// de yang mdo las 'di skad rjes su thos// thog mar snod bcud 'jig rten chags pa yi// sngon gyi sems can zhes bya gang gi gzugs// mdzes shing yan lag nying lag kun tshang zhing*// rang 'od kyis gsal mkha' la bya bzhin du// thogs pa med rgyu rang bzhin dga' bas 'tsho// de lta na yang mngon 'dod lag pa yis// blangs nas bcud kyi zas la brten pa yis// rang 'od la sogs yon tan ji snyed kyang*// chags sogs dri mas rab nongs sā lu'i phyir// ma byin blangs pa dag la spyos pa'i tshe// de dag nang nas zhing khrims byed pa cig /bkrabs nas bskos pa'i mi la drang po zhes// mang pos bkur bas mang bkur rgyal po zhes// thog mar byung zhing de tshe mi dag la// sems can zhes bya tsam las ming gzhan med// mang bkur rigs sras 'od mdzes zhes bya'i tshe// mi rnams bla dgas tshur shog ces par 'bod// 'od mdzes bu ni dge ba zhes bya'i tshe// mi rnams ming la sme ba can du btags// dge ba'i sras la dge mchog ces bya byung*// mi la sprin mgrin zhes so dge mchog bu// gso sbyong 'phags te mi la ta la'i rkang*// gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bor sha rmen byung*// de brtol khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig

/byung ba btsun mo drug khri'i nang bkri tshe// nu mar 'o ma zags pa nga la nus// de skad smras pas nga las nur grags so// de tshe mi rnams sems par byed pa dang*// 'jal bar byed cing nye bar rtog par byed// bzo sogs tha dad las byed de dag ming*// yid las skyes su grags shing nga las nu'i// g.yas pa'i brla la sha rmen byung ba las// khye'u mtshan bzang can byung mdzes par btags// rdzu 'phrul mthu che gling bzhi dbang du byas// de bzhin mdzes pa nye mdzes mdzes ldan dang*// nye mdzes ldan rnams snga ma snga ma yi// yab kyi sku las skyes pa'i phyi ma sras// rim bzhin de dag gling bzhi gling gsum dang*// gling gnyis gling gcig la ni dbang byed byung*// de nas bzang po legs bzang btang ba dang*// btang bzung yan lag yan lag shing rta dang*// ngan spong skal ldan shing rta rgya mtsho dang*// rgya mtsho'i bu dang rgya mtsho chen po dang*// sha ku ni dang sha ku ni chen po// ku sha nye ba'i ku sha ku sha che// legs mthong legs mthong chen po rab thob dang*// rab thob chen po rab tu sgra bsgrags dang*// rab tu sgra bsgrags chen po 'od byed dang*// rtul phod pa dang lhun po ldan dang ni// lhun po yod dang 'od zer 'od zer ldan// 'od zer yod dang kun nas 'od zer ro// kun nas 'od zer zhes bya'i bu tsha bo// yang tsha sum tsha'i brgyud pa rgyal po brgya// yul gru 'dzin du byung ste de rnams kyi// tha ma rgyal po dgra 'dul zhes bya ste// dgra 'dul bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po lnga khri bzhi stong dag ni yul// dmag gis mi tshugs par byung de dag gi /tha ma ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba byung*// de yi bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po sum khri drug stong 'khor mo 'jig /byung ba'i tha ma bzod dka' zhes bya ste// bzod dka'i bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong kim+bi la'i// grong khyer du byung tha ma tshangs byin te// tshangs byin bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po sum khri nyis stong glang po che'i// grong khyer la byung mtha' ma glang pos byin// glang pos byin gyi bu tsha yang tsha dang*// sum tsha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po lnga stong yul// rdo 'jog tu byung de mtha' bal bu can// bal bu can gyi bu tsha yang tsha dang*// sum tsha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sum khri dang*// nyis stong grong khyer brang gis nyal du byung*// de rnams tha ma rgyal po tshan che 'dul// tshan po che 'dul bu tsha yang tsha dang*// sum tsha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sum khri dang*// nyis stong dag ni grong khyer gang gi ming*// ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba zhes byar byung*// de dag tha ma rgyal po rgyal byin te// rgyal byin bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po sum khri nyis stong grong khyer ni// ka n+ya kub+dzar byung ste de'i mtha' ma// rgyal sde zhes byung rgyal sde'i bu tsha dang*// yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyal po khri brgyad stong*// grong khyer tsam par byung ste de rnams kyi// tha ma rgyal po klu yi lha zhes byung*// klu lha'i bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po nyi khri lnga stong grong khyer ni// tā la'i phreng du byung ste de dag gi

/tha ma nyid ni rgyal po mi yi lha// de yi bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po khri phrag nyis stong ta ma lar// byung ste de dag tha ma rgya mtsho'i lha// rgya mtsho'i lha yi bu tsha yang tsha dang*// sum tsha'i rigs brgyud rgyal po khri brgyad stong*// grong khyer ba so'i grong du byung ba yi// tha ma rgyal po blo gros bzang po ste// de yi bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po nyi khri lnga stong grong khyer ni// rgyal po'i khab tu byung ba'i tha ma de// rgyal po mun sel zhes byung de yi bu// tsha bo yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po// brgya phrag grong khyer wā rā ṇa sīr byung*// tha ma dbang phyug chen po'i sde yi bu// tsha bo yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po// brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer rtswa can byung*// tha ma rgya mtsho'i sde yin de yi bu// tsha bo yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud las ni// rgyal po stong yang grong khyer gru 'dzin byung*// tha ma rgyal po dka' thub spyod ces byung*// dka' thub spyod kyi bu tsha yang tsha dang*// sum tsha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong dag kyang grong khyer rtswa can byung*// tha ma rgyal po sa yi gdong zhes byung*// de yi bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po 'bum phrag wā rā ṇa sīr byon// de dag tha ma sa yi bdag po'i bu// tsha dang yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po// 'bum phrag grong khyer dmag gis mi tshugs byung*// kun gyi tha ma sa 'dzin zhes bya ste// sa 'dzin bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong mi thi lar// byung ba'i tha ma rgyal po lha chen po// zhes bya byung ngo de yi bu tsha bo// yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po ni// brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer mi thi lar// byung zhing drang srong tshangs par spyod spyad de// de rnams kyi ni tha ma mu khyud ces// bya ba'i rgyal po byung ste mu khyud las// 'bying ba dang ni sra ba'i mu khyud dang*// rko ba nye bar rko dang rko ba yod// kun nas rko dang gya nom snang ba dang*// thos pa'i sde dang chos sde rtogs pa dang*// rtogs pa chen po rtogs pa'i sde dang ni// mya ngan med dang mya ngan bral ba dang*// brtan pa'i sde dag rga bas sbyar dang ni// glen bsang skya rengs phyogs kyi bdag po dang*// rtul can bde byed kun dga' me long gdong*// skyed pa dang ni kun nas skyed pa dang*// skye bo'i khyu mchog bza' btung can dang ni// bza' btung mang can mi thub gzhan mi thub// gnas pa shin tu gnas pa stobs chen dang*// stobs chen zhon dang legs pa'i blo gros dang*// brtan pa zhon dang gzhu bcu gzhu brgya pa// gzhu ni dgu bcu gzhu rgyal gzhu bkra dang*// gzhu sra shing rta bcu pa shing rta brgya// shing rta dgu bcu shing rta khra bo dang*// shing rta rgyal dang shing rta sra ba'o// rgyal po shing rta sra ba'i bu tsha dang*// yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po ni// bdun khri bdun stong grong khyer kun snang byung*// tha ma rgyal po kṛ kī de yi tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs 'jig rten byon// kṛ kī'i bu ni legs skyes zhes bya ste// de yi bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po brgya phrag grong khyer gru 'dzin byung*// de dag kun gyi tha ma rna ba can// rna can zhes bya'i rigs sras gau ta ma// bha ra dwa dza gnyis las phyi ma de// rgyal srid nyid la dga' bas de dbang bskur// dang po rgyal srid nyes pas yid skyo nas// drang srong mdog gnag ces bya'i drung du song*// rab tu byung nas drang srong gau tam grags// ji tsam zhig na drang srong gau ta mas// grong 'dabs gnas mal chog par mkhan por zhus// de yis gnang nas bag dang ldan sems kyis// gru 'dzin nye 'khor lo ma'i spyil bur gnas// yul der gnas pa'i smad 'tshong bzang mo la// skyes bu g.yon can pad+ma'i rtsa lag gis// dga' mgur spyad phyir gos dang rgyan bsrings nas// chas pa'i lam du kār+sha pa ṇi ni// lnga brgya thogs pa'i 'dod ldan dbang du song*// bran mo mngags nas pad+ma'i rtsa lag la// re zhig 'gyangs dang slad kyis mchi bar mchid// bran mos rje mo'i skyon bcas shub bur bzlas// g.yon can khros pa'i drung du mtshan gyi thun// dang po 'das tsam song ba de yis bsad// mngag gzhug ma yi cho nges kun du bsgrags// de la skrag nas pad+ma'i rtsa lag gis// ral gri khrag can gau ta ma yi mdun// bor nas skye bo'i tshogs su yud kyis bros// skye bo'i tshogs kyis ral gri khrag can de// drang srong de yi drung mthong 'di skad smras// rab tu byung 'dis bzang mo bsad do zhes// drang srong gau ta ma de bzung nas bcings// de skad rim bzhin rgyal por bsnyad pa na// rgyal po rnams ni ma brtag par spyod pas// ngan pa 'di ngas spangs kyi gsal shing gshon// zhes gsungs 'phral la rab tu byung ba de// me tog ka ra bī ra'i phreng ba yis// mgul pa la btags skyes pa gos sngon can// mtshon chas lag brel gyis khrid lho phyogs kyi// sgor phyung gson pa nyid du gsal shing gshon// ji tsam zhig na mkhan po mdog nag nyid// rtag tu de yi bsti gnas 'ongs pa la// de tshe gzhan du song bas de ma mthong*// btsal ba brtsams nas gsal shing gshon pa mthong*// mod la mchi mas rab gang mig gis bltas// snying rje'i tshig gis dal bus kyi hud bu// 'di ni ci ga bu yi lus la rma// phyung ba nyid dam gnod pa ma byas grang*// des kyang mkhan po bdag ni lus kyi rma// phyung yang sems kyis de lta ma yin smras// ji ltar shes na mkhan po bden gsol gson// bdag gi lus kyis rma phyung sems kyis min// bden pa de yis mkhan po'i pags pa'i mdog

/nag po gang yin gser gyi mdog gyur cig /smras pa'i 'phral la pags pa gser mdog song*// phyin chad drang srong gser mdog ces byar grags// ngo mtshar gyur nas mkhan por 'di skad gsol// bdag ni 'di nas shi 'phos 'gro ba gang*// skyes pa dang ni phyi ma gang zhig lags// smras tshe bram ze rnams ni bu med par// 'gro ba med zer khyod kyis bu bskyed dam// gsol ba mkhan po yab kyis rgyal srid la// spro ba bskyed pas ma bzlog rab byung nas// bdag gi bud med rgyus kyang ma mtshal na// bu skye ba dag lta yang ga la mchis// mkhan pos smras pa de lta nyid na sngon// yul la spyad pa rjes su dran par bskul// chor ba drag pos nyen pas dran ma gyur// de yi phyir na mkhan pos rdzu 'phrul gyis// rdzi char drag po phab pa'i grang reg gis// lus la reg pas sdug bsngal mnan pa'i tshe// des sngon yul la spyad pa rjes sems pas// chags pas sa bon thigs gnyis khrag bcas lhung*// de gnyis sgo nga gnyis gyur nyi ma yi// 'od kyis reg smin nam zhig rdol ba na// khye'u gnyis shig byung bas bu ram gyi// shing gi nags tshal gseb tu zhugs gyur to// skabs der nyi ma'i 'od kyi tsha gdung gis// drang srong gau ta ma nyid dus byas so// gser mdog 'ongs pas de ni shi ba mthong*// nye 'khor de ru sgong khog rdol ba'ang mthong*// de yi rkyen gyis nags khrod der btsal bas// khye'u gnyis shig mthong ba su yin snyam// brtags pas gau ta ma yi bur shes nas// de gnyis bsti gnas la khrid bsnun gsos te// nyi ma'i drod kyis smin byas skyes gyur pas// nyi ma'i rigs dang gau tam gyis skyed pa'i// rgyu mtshan de'i gau ta ma zhes grags// rang gi yan lag las byung yan lag skyes// bur shing tshal nas rnyed phyir bu ram shing*// zhes byar btags pa'i ming yang bzhi byung ngo*// ji tsam zhig na bha ra dwa dza la// rgyal sras med par dus byas blon po rnams// mchid du bgros tshe gzhan dag 'di skad smras// gcen po gau ta ma ni drang srong khrod// rab tu byung ba shes nas dbang bskur phyir// drang srong gser mdog drung phyin gau ta ma// gang du mchis zhes smras tshe khyed cag gis// bsad do zhes smras de dag mi dran zer// slar yang sdig med ji ltar bsad pa'i tshul// zhib tu smras pas yid ches shin tu 'gyod// de tshe khye'u gnyis kyang drang srong mdun// 'ongs pa blon po rnams mthong su zhes dris// lan du de yi bu ste byung tshul bcas// lo rgyus gtam du glengs pas ngo mtshar skyes// drang srong gsol btab phu bo rgyal srid bzhag

/de la rigs sras med par dus byas so// slar yang cig shos nu bo rgyal sar bzhag /rgyal po bu ram shing pa zhes byar gyur// de yi bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i rgyud// rgyal po bu ram shing pa brgya phrag kyang*// grong khyer gru 'dzin la byung tha ma ni// bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po zhes bya// 'phags skyes po la bu bzhi skar mda' gdong*// lag rna glang po che 'dul rkang gdub can// dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo dam ma shi// de yis rgyal po mya ngan sems khong chud// gang tshe blon po rnams kyis ci slad lha// btsun mo dam ma mi btsal zhes su gsol// smras pa gzhon nu 'di dag rgyal srid la// mngon par 'dod pas phyir rgol dag yod na// su zhig nga la ster bar 'gyur ram gleng*// de tshe blon rnams btsal bar dam bcas bzhin// ji tsam na ni rgyal po gzhan zhig la// bu mo blta sdug btsun mor 'os pa byung*// de la bslangs pas lan du 'di skad smras// 'thab rir bab pa'i mchog ni yin pas de// rung na 'on te sngon du dam 'cha' ba// nga yi bu mor gal te bu mchis na// rgyal srid dbang phyug bzhag pa lta na sbyin// zhes bsrings lha ni de bzhin 'tshal mchi zhes// lha la snyan du gdas zhes de rnams song*// rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes por// ji ltar bsrings pa'i gtam dag snyan du gsol// de yis phu bo spangs nas nu bo la// rgyal srid bsko ba 'os min smras gyur kyang*// blon po'i rig pas gal te bu 'byung ngam// bu mo 'byung ba nges pa ma mchis pas// re zhig btsun mor blang rung zhes gsol bar// rgyal pos kyang ni gnang nas btsun mor blang*// nam zhig dus na khye'u gzugs mdzes shig /btsun mo'i mchog de las ni skyes par gyur// khye'u'i ming la rgyal srid dga' zhes btags// rgyal srid ma bzhag zhang pos thos gyur te// pho nya btang nas tshig rtsub spring yig bskur// de la skrag ste blon rnams 'di skad bgros// nu bo rgyal srid bzhag nas phu bo rnams// yul gzhan spyugs par rigs pa rgyal por gsol// de la rgyal po shin tu dgyes ma gyur// de lta na yang thabs gzhan ma rnyed nas// rgyal po gzhon nu rnams las thugs 'byung slad// blon po rnams kyis yid 'bab skyed mo'i tshal// ri mo la sogs kun nas nyams dga' bskrun// de mthong gzhon nu rnams kyis su yi dris// lha yi yin smras de rnams de nyid nas// ldog par brtsams kyang blon rnams bslu thabs kyis// gzhon nu rnams ni 'jug kyang ci 'gal zhes// 'khyog po'i tshig la yid brtan de ru zhugs// de tshe rings par rings par blon po yis// rgyal po skyed mos tshal du spyan 'dren zhus// chas pa'i lam du ca co'i sgra dag thos// 'di na su zhig dris tshe gzhon nu rnams// yod par shes nas de la rgyal po khros// gzhon nu de rnams nga yis spangs so smras// de la blon rnams dga' ba'i legs so gsol// nu bo rgyal srid dga' de rgyal por bskos// gzhan rnams sring mor bcas pa gangs can gyi// ri bor nye ba'i skal ldan shing rta yi// chu 'gram drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang*// nye bar lo 'dab spyil bu can du btang*// de na ri dwags sha yi 'tsho ba bsten// lang tsho dar bab mngon 'dod bsam gtan gyis// lus skems kha dog skya bseng gyur pa rnams// drang srong ser skyas mthong nas 'di skad bslab// rgyal rigs rgyal srid stor ba khyed cag rnams// rang rang sring mo spangs nas mas dbyen gyi// sring mo rnams dang lhan cig rtse dga' rung*// smras de tshad mar bzung nas 'dod chags mes// nyen pa de dag ma yis dbyen gyi sring*// lhan cig rtse zhing dga' mgur spyod pa na// bu dang bu mo btsas pa cher skyes pa'i// klag cor sgra yis ser skya'i bsam gtan par// mi gnod ched du drang srong ser skya yis// sa phyogs phog par grong khyer brtsigs pa la// ser skya'i gzhi zhes bya bar ming du grags// der yang skye bo'i tshogs 'phel che ba'i rgyus// dogs pa lha rnams shes nas phyogs gzhan bstan// de na'ang grong khyer brtsigs der lhas bstan grags// de nas de dag 'dus te 'di skad bcas// rigs mnyam pa las chun ma blangs pa yis// rang re sa 'dir spyugs pa'i rgyu dag byas// des na phyin chad mnyam pa gcig nyid las// chung ma len gyi chun ma mi len bcas// nam zhig tshe na rgyal po 'phags skyes pos// de ltar gzhon nu de rnams sring mo dang*// lhan cig gnas pa'i lo rgyus thos pa'i tshe// ched du brjod par kye ma gzhon nu rnams// phod pa yin no shin tu phod pa yin// de skad smras phyir shākya zhes su grags// dus gzhan zhig nas yab gcig 'phags skyes po// shi nas rgyal srid dga' ba rgyal por bskur// de la rgyal bu med par tshe dus byas// skar mda' gdong dang lag sna glang po 'dul// rgyal srid rim bzhag sngar bzhin dus byas so// de rjes rkang gdub can nyid rgyal por gyur// de yi bu ni gnas 'jog de yi bu// sa khyim zhes bya rgyal po sa khyim gyi// bu tsha yang tsha sum tsha'i brgyud pa las// rgyal po lnga khri lnga stong ser skya'i gzhir// byung ba'i tha ma shing rta bcu pa dang*// shing rta brgya pa shing rta dgu bcu pa// shing rta khra bo dang ni shing rta rgyal// brtan pa'i shing rta gzhu bcu gzhu brgya pa// gzhu ni dgu bcu gzhu rgyal gzhu bkra dang*// gzhu brtan zhes bya byung ngo gzhu brtan sras// seng ge 'gram dang seng ge'i sgra gnyis po// dang po gzhu thogs kun gyi mchog tu grags// seng ge 'gram gyi sras bzhi zas gtsang dang*// zas dkar bre bo zas dang bdud rtsi zas// bu mo gtsang ma dkar mo bre mo dang*// bdud rtsi ma'o zas gtsang bu gnyis te// bcom ldan 'das dang dga' bo rnam gnyis so// zas dkar sras ni tshe dang ldan pa rgyal// shākya rgyal po bzang ldan zhes bya gnyis// bre bo zas kyi bu gnyis ming chen dang*// tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa ste gnyis// bdud rtsi zas zhes bya ba'i bu gnyis ni// tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang ni// lha sbyin zhes bya'i khengs ldan de nyid yin// gtsang ma'i bu ni legs par rab sad do// dkar mo'i bu ni phreng ba can zhes bya// bre bo ma yi bu ni bzang len ldan// bdud rtsi ma yi bu ni dge 'phel lo// don kun grub pa'i sras ni sgra gcan 'dzin// mang pos bkur ba'i rgyud ni rigs kyi sras// tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan 'dzin nas rdzogs// de tshe grong khyer ser skya zhes bya'i gzhir// seng ge 'gram zhes bya bas rgyal srid skyong*// lhas bstan du ni legs par rab sad kyis// rgyal srid bskyangs pas yul phyogs bde la bkod// legs par rab sad kyis ni btsun mo'i mchog

/lum+bi nī zhes bya ba'i don slad du// snga na med pa'i kun dga' rwa ba zhig /me tog 'bras bu chu klung la sogs pas// yid du 'ong ba bskrun pa de yi ming*// lum+bi nī yi tshal zhes bya bar gyur// legs par rab sad la ni sgyu ma dang*// sgyu ma chen mo zhes bya'i bu mo gnyis// gzugs mdzes stobs dang 'khor los sgyur ba'i bu// rim bzhin 'byung ba'i mtshan ma can gnyis byung*// chen mor gyur nas legs par rab sad kyis// seng ge 'gram la phrin du 'di skad phul// bdag gi bu mo gnyis kyi mtshan ma bcas// rgyas par brjod nas de gnyis gang bzhed cig /gzhon nu zas gtsang chung mar snoms shig bsring*// seng ge 'gram gyis lan du slar spring ba// bu mo gnyis ka gzhon nu la 'os kyang*// re zhig 'khor los sgyur bar bskyed pa'i mtshan// gang yod de blangs cig shos tshogs su brtag /de skad smras nas ring zhig lon pa na// shākya rnams kyi phyir rgol ri khrod pa// skya bseng zhes bya mngon par bcom pa'i grogs// gzhon nu zas gtsang btang ba yab la zhus// yab kyis ji ltar mngon 'dod dam pa zhig /bslang ba'i g.yar dam bcas nas gzhon nu btang*// gzhon nu'i dpung gis dgra rnams rmeg tu bcom// de la shākya rnams kyang rab dgyes nas// ji ltar mngon 'dod dam bca' gsungs shig gsol// sngon dus shākya rnams kyis khrims bcas pa// mnyam pa las ni chung ma blang bya yi// chun ma blang bar mi bya zhes bcas kyang*// gzhon nu'i don du dam pa cig slong ba// mnyam pa las ni chun ma blang ngo gsung*// de nyid rung ngo de ltar mdzod cig zhus// de 'phral nyid du legs par rab sad la// kho bos tshogs su legs par brtags zin gyis// bu mo cig shos kyang ni bkri shig ces// pho nya btang ba bzhin du des kyang byin// ji tsam zhig na rgyal po seng ge 'gram// dus byas pa na rgyal srid zas gtsang gis// legs par skyong gin bzhugs pa'i dus shig na// btsun mo dam pa sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang*// lhan cig steng gi khang bzang skye bo yis// dben par rtse 'jo dgyes dgur rol pa na// dga' ldan lha yi gnas nas dam pa tog

/rang gi cod paṇa ma pham dbu la bcings// chos kyi rgyal tshab mchog tu mnga' dbang bskur// rang nyid gzhan don dus babs legs par mkhyen// byang chub sems dpa'i rigs dang yul dang dus// rgyud dang bud med rnams te gzigs pa lngas// de nas nyer 'phos thal kar glang chen gyi// phru gu mche ba drug ldan tshul gyis gshegs// lhums su zhag gi phung po bcu rdzogs nas// lum+bi nī yi tshal du sngon med kyi// ngo mtshar ltas bzang lhan cig bltams pa sogs// 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir bcu gnyis mdzad pa yis// mi mjed 'jig rten yid bzang tshogs dang bcas// grangs med gdul bya'i re ba cig car du// yongs su 'gengs mdzad chos kyi nyi ma de// bdag cag rnams kyi bsod nams skal bas thob// smras pa/ thub mchog gang las 'khrungs pa'i sngon rabs las// 'phos pa'i chos gtam dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i glu// su zhig mgrin las 'jo de chos dang don// tshangs par spyad don ldan par rgyal bas gsungs// chos min gtam gyi lha chen khros pa'i mdas// chos spyod grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs pa dang*// ston pa'i sngon rabs rā ma ṇa yi mdas// sgrib pa'i bden bral snying 'bigs ci ste mtshungs// ngag tshig 'di la ngal byas dge ba yis// sa gsum yi ges dbul ba dpyis 'byin du// byed pa smra ba'i dbang phyug mngon gyur nas// go 'phang mchog der 'gro rnams 'khrid par shog /ces ston mchog gang las byon pa'i shākya rnams kyi sngon rabs gleng ba'i chos gtam dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni don kun grub pa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i rjes su slob cing rjes su sgrub pa'i 'dun pa ma bor tsam gyi ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la rjes su smon pa'i btags ming ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bod pas lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig maṅga laṃ//
